answer_1.quote: Last, our findings suggest an exciting avenue for model fusion as a tool for mitigating memorization and preserving privacy. By comparing memorization before and after fusion, we demonstrate that fusion can reduce the leakage of personal information from training datasets into learned models ( §6).
